summary: Tested AUTHENTICATED SCANNING feature end-to-end. Backend: /app/tests suite (45 tests) passes; new /app/backend/tests/test_auth_scan_e2e.py (9 tests) passes covering profile CRUD masking, VALID/INVALID test, out-of-scope check_url guard, authenticated scan crawling /dashboard/search & /dashboard/profile, AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED on invalid creds, findings-evidence redaction, /logout not crawled, stats.auth_status. Existing /app/backend/tests/test_api_e2e.py (6 tests) still passes. Frontend UI E2E via Playwright: Sidebar Auth Profiles nav works, profile creation with masked cookie in list, Test button returns VALID pill, Scans page scan-auth-profile dropdown lists profiles for selected project, ScanDetail shows scan-auth-badge 'auth · VALID' with findings on /dashboard/search and /dashboard/profile and NO raw cookie leaked in the rendered page. AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED scan status also observed in scans list. Everything green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~460 lines and still growing; consider splitting auth-profile + scan endpoints into separate routers as it approaches the 700-line threshold.
test_auth_profile expects a JSON body even when empty; frontend already sends {} but consider making body Optional or accepting empty body to reduce client friction.

AuthProfile secret masking is verified in list output, but note masking is validated only via public_auth_profile — direct DB reads still contain raw values (expected, but ensure no future endpoint returns raw config).
test_credentials: admin@local.dev / admin123; test-target cookie value session=authed-session-token-abc123
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed projects and profiles during E2E runs; UI-side created 'TEST_ui_prof_*' auth profile. These are transient test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The pytest.ini in /app/backend forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; when running a single file use `-n 0` (NOT `-p no:xdist`). Test target Flask app at localhost:5000 must be running; endpoints /login, /dashboard, /dashboard/search, /dashboard/profile all functional. AuthProfile POST payload nests cookies/check_url/login_indicators under `config` key. /test endpoint requires JSON body (send {} minimum).
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. During test authoring, initial payload used flat fields (cookies/check_url) which returned 400 because server expects them nested under `config`; also /test endpoint requires JSON body. Fixed the tests, not the backend.
